# Tool capability catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-catalog.mjs from shared/tool-catalog.js; do not edit. -->

This is static capability information, not a promise that a tool is enabled or free. Runtime discovery through `offense.security_tools` or the CLI is authoritative for availability, current input contracts and pricing. Obtain a current quote before paid execution.

Required fields below are those explicitly declared in the static catalog; their absence is not an empty input contract. Inspect runtime tool details and the [tool operations guide](tools.md) before execution. Choose checks using [check selection](check-selection.md), preserving the requested scope and existing authorization.

## `opengrep` — Source code security

Input family: `source-files`.

Operator-maintained JavaScript, TypeScript and Python patterns and within-file taint rules; no exploit confirmation

## `trivy-vuln` — Dependency vulnerabilities

Input family: `source-files`.

Supported dependency manifests and lockfiles

## `gitleaks` — Exposed secrets

Input family: `source-files`.

Uploaded file contents; Git history is excluded

## `trivy-config` — Infrastructure configuration

Input family: `source-files`.

Supported infrastructure-as-code files

## `trivy-sbom` — SBOM vulnerabilities

Input family: `sbom-json`.

One CycloneDX or SPDX JSON file

## `trivy-image` — Container image vulnerabilities

Input family: `image-tar`.

One uploaded, digest-checked Docker image archive, up to 80 MiB

## `gitleaks-history` — Git history secrets

Input family: `git-bundle`.

One bounded Git bundle; redacted findings from prior commits

## `guarddog-npm` — npm package risk

Input family: `package-archive`.

One uploaded npm package archive; suspicious package behavior signals

## `guarddog-pypi` — PyPI package risk

Input family: `package-archive`.

One uploaded PyPI package archive; suspicious package behavior signals

## `spectral-owasp` — OpenAPI security policy

Input family: `openapi-text`.

One uploaded OpenAPI JSON or YAML document; specification checks only

## `cosign-image` — Container image provenance

Input family: `cosign-save`.

One offline Cosign image bundle, expected signer and OCI digest

## `zap-passive-har` — Passive web response checks

Input family: `web-har`.

One uploaded HAR with at most 200 captured responses; no live crawl or active requests

## `zizmor` — GitHub Actions security

Input family: `source-files`.

Supplied workflow and action YAML; offline trust-boundary, injection and permission checks

## `osv-scanner` — Dependency remediation intelligence

Input family: `source-files`.

Offline OSV advisory matches and advisory-listed fixed versions for supported supplied lockfiles; no dependency installation, automatic fix or exploit confirmation

## `semgrep` — Semgrep source code security

Input family: `source-files`.

Additional operator-reviewed JavaScript, TypeScript and Python rules using Semgrep Community Edition; no remote registry rules, cross-file reachability or exploit confirmation

## `k8s-deprecations` — Kubernetes API deprecations

Input family: `source-files`.
Required fields: `files`, `kubernetesVersion`.
Supported Kubernetes versions: `1.32.0`, `1.33.0`, `1.34.0`, `1.35.0`.

Rendered YAML/JSON manifests against Pluto’s bundled Kubernetes API lifecycle data for the required kubernetesVersion; no cluster access or upgrade safety guarantee

## `k8s-manifest-validate` — Kubernetes manifest validation

Input family: `source-files`.
Required fields: `files`, `kubernetesVersion`.
Supported Kubernetes versions: `1.32.0`, `1.33.0`, `1.34.0`, `1.35.0`.

Strict offline validation of rendered YAML/JSON manifests against bundled schemas for the required kubernetesVersion; missing custom-resource schemas remain partial

## `nuclei` — Deployment exposure checks

Input family: `verified-target`.

Four fixed checks for exposed Git configuration, dotenv, actuator environment and directory listings; no general CVE coverage

## `prowler-cloudflare` — Cloudflare account security

Input family: `cloud-account`.

Read-only Prowler checks in one explicitly selected Cloudflare account

## `schemathesis` — API fuzz testing

Input family: `verified-api`.

Bounded schema-generated requests; failures require application-specific review

## `zap-api` — Active API security

Input family: `verified-api`.

SQL injection, path traversal and CRLF injection checks plus passive response checks on one verified staging API

## `sslyze` — TLS configuration

Input family: `verified-target`.

Certificate validation, Heartbleed and OpenSSL CCS injection on one verified HTTPS hostname; no full protocol or cipher enumeration

## `katana` — Web and API endpoint discovery

Input family: `verified-target`.

GET-only discovery on one verified HTTPS origin, at most 50 pages and two link levels; no browser, forms, authenticated sessions or exploit confirmation

## `httpx` — Live service reconnaissance

Input family: `verified-target`.

One HTTPS root response: service status, content type, size and detected technologies; no port scan, redirect following or vulnerability confirmation

## `openssf-scorecard` — Supply-chain trust assessment

Input family: `public-repository`.

Published OpenSSF Scorecard snapshot for a public GitHub repository, with assessed commit, date and check scores; no fresh scan or private repository access

## `checkov` — Infrastructure graph review

Input family: `source-files`.

Offline infrastructure policy checks; no cloud account access

## `trufflehog-verified` — Live secret verification

Input family: `source-files`.

Uploaded files and a curated set of live credential verifiers; no Git history

## `mobsf-static` — Mobile release security

Input family: `mobile-app`.

Static APK or IPA analysis; no emulator or dynamic execution
